instruction: Write INVENTORY.md for everything under data/: one line per regular file (not directories, links or anything else), `<path relative to data/> | <size in bytes> | <first 12 hex of its sha256>`, sorted by path. If a file can't be read, put `unreadable` instead of the hash. Then a last line `invoice_lines: <n>`: how many lines across those files contain `invoice` (case-sensitive). Don't change anything under data/.
